name: Gwalior

queries.query: ग्वालियर शहरी भू नक्शा भू अभिलेख नजूल भूमि मानचित्र आधिकारिक
queries.scope: Find Gwalior-specific first-party urban land-record/map services and parcel geometry.
queries.result: The official Gwalior district site publishes Nazul Land Information PDFs for named urban areas including Goshpura, Kotalashkar, Morar and Purani Chawni, and lists Gwalior GIS. The state/district land-records directory identifies the Land Records & Settlements Commissioner in Gwalior. These establish local land-record functions and static information, not an anonymous parcel-vector endpoint.
queries.executionMethod: Separate Hindi-language search and review of district-owned pages; bounded GET to official GIS target timed out locally and is left inconclusive.

queries.query: Gwalior official city cadastral parcel map land records Nazul GIS Madhya Pradesh
queries.scope: Cross-check local urban records and public map access.
queries.result: First-party Gwalior district and Government of India DILRMP pages confirm district cadastral-map digitization and Gwalior GIS. The public GIS is described as infrastructure/land-use data, and the official Nazul page offers static PDFs by locality. The linked GIS host timed out from this environment; no public parcel geometry or exact WUP-village selection was verified.
queries.executionMethod: Separate English-language search and official district/state page review; one bounded anonymous viewer GET.

portals.name: Gwalior GIS
portals.operator: District Administration, Government of Madhya Pradesh
portals.observation: District page links the Gwalior GIS portal and describes district-level roads, water, sewer, land-use, public assets, schools, hospitals and other infrastructure layers; no cadastral parcel layer is named.

portals.name: NAZUL Land Information
portals.operator: District Administration, Government of Madhya Pradesh
portals.observation: Official district page publishes downloadable locality-specific PDFs for 14 named areas. The files are static records, not a public vector query service. The district page indicates its last update was July 22, 2019.

portals.name: Land Records & Settlements directory
portals.operator: District Administration, Government of Madhya Pradesh / Commissioner Land Records
portals.observation: District directory identifies the Land Records & Settlements Commissioner office in Gwalior.

portals.name: DILRMP Gwalior district map-status page
portals.operator: Department of Land Resources, Government of India
portals.observation: District-specific MIS reports cadastral-map digitization and georeferencing by Gwalior tehsil, including Gird; this is coverage status, not a public geometry API.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official district sources identify Gwalior land records, local Nazul locality PDFs and a linked district GIS. DILRMP reports district cadastral map status by tehsil.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: The linked public GIS shell timed out locally; its district page describes infrastructure/land-use themes. No exact WUP point village or parcel geometry was confirmed.

registryBasis: First-party Gwalior district pages identify a local Land Records & Settlements office and locality-level Nazul information; the official district GIS and district-specific cadastral status support local land-record coverage.
technicalBlocker: The only public local cadastral information verified is static locality PDF material and district status reporting; the official GIS page does not advertise parcel layers, and its linked viewer timed out locally.
remainingUncertainty: Whether the Gwalior urban tehsil/village maps are exposed through a separate working vector viewer and whether the WUP point resolves to a specific urban parcel. The locality PDF index page is marked last updated July 2019.
nextStep: If continued, identify the official city-scale cadastral route and exact tehsil/village for the WUP point; test anonymous full-feature geometry before any adapter integration.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
